2607.01982.title: MolSight: A Graph-Aware Vision-Language Model for Unified Chemical Image Understanding
2607.01982.paper_summary: Using molecular large language models (LLMs) as a unified framework for understanding molecular structures and functions is emerging as a new trend in tasks such as molecular design and drug discovery. However, these models struggle to fully capture the visual representation of molecular structures, limiting their potential. While existing molecular vision-language models (VLMs) show promise, they still face challenges in structural alignment and lack the necessary topological modeling for accurate molecular understanding. To address this, we propose MolSight, a graph-aware vision-language model framework designed to enhance the understanding of molecular images by VLMs. MolSight integrates a Molecular Topology Module to inject chemical-bond adjacency information into vision tokens, and a Molecular Grounding Module to align visual features with chemical symbolic semantics. Our experiments demonstrate that MolSight significantly outperforms existing VLMs, molecular LLMs, and specialized tools across multiple chemical visual understanding tasks, achieving a new level of molecular image reasoning.
2607.01982.paper_summary_zh: 使用分子大型語言模型（LLMs）作為理解分子結構和功能的統一框架，正在成為分子設計和藥物發現等任務中的一個新趨勢。<lb/>然而，這些模型在充分捕捉分子結構的視覺表現方面存在困難，限制了它們的潛力。<lb/>儘管現有的分子視覺-語言模型（VLMs）顯示出潛力，但它們在結構對齊方面仍面臨挑戰，並且缺乏準確理解分子所需的拓撲建模。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了MolSight，一個圖形感知的視覺-語言模型框架，旨在通過VLMs增強對分子圖像的理解。<lb/>MolSight整合了一個分子拓撲模塊，將化學鍵相鄰信息注入視覺標記中，以及一個分子定位模塊，將視覺特徵與化學符號語義對齊。<lb/>我們的實驗表明，MolSight在多個化學視覺理解任務中顯著超越了現有的VLMs、分子LLMs和專門工具，達到了分子圖像推理的新水平。
